description_en: Creates a read-only shard account for a cloud disk-based ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 创建MongoDB云盘版分片集群实例的Shard只读账号
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-account --db-instance-id dds-uf6e9433e955xxxx --account-name admin1 --account-password 'Test123456!' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. For a sharded cluster instance, specify the ID of the sharded cluster. Account operations are performed from the perspective of the Configserver
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。分片集群实例请传入分片集群ID，账号操作以config server视角执行
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The account name. The name must be 2 to 16 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit. You cannot use the system-reserved account name root or the reserved prefix __cloud
parameters.help_zh: 账号名。由小写字母、数字或下划线组成，以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾，长度为2~16个字符。不能使用系统保留账号名root或保留前缀__cloud
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The account password. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =

For more information about how to handle special characters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.help_zh:
账户密码。
大写、小写、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为8~32个字符；特殊字符为 ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =

特殊字符的处理方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The type of the account to be created. Valid values:
db: a shard direct connection account for a sharded cluster.
cs: a Configserver account for a sharded cluster.
normal: a standard database account for a replica set.

Default value: db
parameters.help_zh:
创建账号类型。取值：
db：分片集群shard直连账号。
cs：分片集群config server账号。
normal：副本集普通数据库账号。

默认值：db
parameters.name: character_type

fields.help_en: The database referenced by the role, which is the database where the role takes effect. For the value limits of built-in roles, see the Roles parameter description. For a custom role, you must specify the database where the role is defined, which can be queried by calling the DescribeAccountRoles operation. You cannot specify other databases
fields.help_zh: 角色引用库，即该角色生效的库。内置角色的取值限制请参见Roles参数描述；自定义角色必须填写该角色的定义库（可通过DescribeAccountRoles查询），不可指定其他库
fields.name: db_name

fields.help_en: The role name. It can be a built-in role or a custom role created on the instance. For the value rules, see Roles parameter description (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/manage-database-accounts-through-the-console)
fields.help_zh: 角色名称。可以是内置角色或实例上已创建的自定义角色，取值规则请参见Roles参数描述 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/mongodb/manage-database-accounts-through-the-console?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-26556.d_2_4_0.463f1e24s7sunh&scm=20140722.H_3172083._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1)
fields.name: role

parameters.help_en: The list of roles authorized for the account
parameters.name: roles

parameters.help_en: The database to which the account belongs, which is the database where the account is created or on which the account operates. Default value: admin. Rules: The name must be 1 to 63 characters in length and cannot contain /, \, ., spaces, ", or $. The name cannot be local
parameters.help_zh: 账号所在库（账号建在/操作于哪个库），缺省 admin；规则：长度1~63，禁 /、\、.、空格、"、$，禁 local
parameters.name: db_name
